description.value: Hoja Mongolian Grill is a build-your-own stir-fry restaurant in Kamloops where diners choose their own meats, noodles, vegetables, and sauces, then watch a chef cook it on a large communal grill. An all-you-can-eat dine-in option is available alongside takeout and delivery. A smaller express location operates in the Aberdeen Mall food court under the Hoja Express brand.
